gloss: no shoes allowed; shoes strictly prohibited

definitions.gloss: no shoes allowed; shoes strictly prohibited
definitions.explanation: A common sign or rule indicating that outdoor shoes must not be worn in a particular area. Found at the entrance of Japanese homes, temples, certain restaurants, and other spaces where shoes must be removed.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{土足厳禁|どそくげんきん}です。
{入口|いりぐち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{土足厳禁|どそくげんきん}」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a 'no shoes' sign at the entrance.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{土足厳禁|どそくげんきん}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{上履|うわば}き→上履き：10240_uwabaki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{履|は}き{替|か}えて→履き替える：06680_hakikaeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: This gymnasium is a no-shoes area, so please change into indoor shoes.

notes:
{土足厳禁|どそくげんきん} is a common sign in Japan meaning "no outdoor shoes allowed." Composed of ⟦{土足|どそく}→土足：12046_dosoku⟧ (outdoor shoes, literally "earth feet") + ⟦{厳禁|げんきん}→厳禁：18021_genkin⟧ (strictly prohibited).

WHERE YOU SEE IT:
- ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧ (traditional inns) and ⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧ (temples)
- ⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧ (gymnasiums) and ⟦{道場|どうじょう}→道場：14326_doujou⟧ (martial arts halls)
- ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧ (schools)
- Traditional ⟦{和食|わしょく}→和食：10436_washoku⟧ restaurants with tatami rooms
